playground.title: Playground
playground.empty.title: Try a model
playground.empty.description: Pick a model below and type a message. Examples fill the input box so you can edit them before sending.
playground.starter.explain.title: Explain a concept
playground.starter.explain.prompt: Explain what an API gateway is in plain language, with one real-world example.
playground.starter.summarize.title: Summarize text
playground.starter.summarize.prompt: Summarize the following text in 3 bullet points:
playground.starter.code.title: Write code
playground.starter.code.prompt: Write a Python function that checks whether a string is a valid IPv4 address, with a few test cases.
playground.starter.translate.title: Translate
playground.starter.translate.prompt: Translate into Chinese, giving a formal and a casual version: We are shipping the new release next Monday.
playground.input.placeholder: Type a message. Enter to send, Shift + Enter for a new line
playground.input.footnote: Each message is billed like a normal API call · Chat history stays in this browser
playground.clear.description: All Playground messages saved in this browser will be removed. This cannot be undone.
playground.code.title: View code
playground.code.description: Send the same request with an API key. The example uses the current model, the enabled parameters and your latest message.
playground.code.keyHint: Replace YOUR_API_KEY with one of your API keys.
playground.code.groupHint: When you call the API, the group comes from the key's settings. The Playground currently uses the "{{group}}" group.
playground.error.quota.title: Insufficient balance
playground.error.quota.description: Your balance does not cover the estimated cost of this request. Top up and try again; if Max Tokens is enabled, lowering it also reduces the estimate.
playground.error.modelUnavailable.title: This model is not available right now
playground.error.modelUnavailable.descri: No route in the current group serves this model. Try another model or group; if it keeps failing, contact the administrator.
playground.error.modelPrice.title: This model has no price yet
playground.error.modelPrice.description: The model cannot be used until it has a price. Pick another model or contact the administrator.
playground.error.modelPrice.adminHint: Administrators: set a price for this model in the admin console's model pricing settings (not available on this site).
playground.error.groupForbidden.title: You can't use this group
playground.error.groupForbidden.descript: Your account is not allowed to use the selected group. Choose another group and try again.
playground.error.invalidRequest.title: Invalid request
playground.error.invalidRequest.descript: The request parameters were rejected. Check the parameter settings (for example Max Tokens) and try again.
playground.error.busy.title: Service busy
playground.error.busy.description: There are too many requests right now. Wait a moment and try again.
playground.error.auth.title: Session expired
playground.error.auth.description: Refresh the page or sign in again, then retry.
playground.error.network.title: Connection failed
playground.error.network.description: The response did not arrive completely. Check your connection and try again.
playground.error.generic.title: Request failed
playground.error.generic.description: The model service returned an error. Retry, or try another model.
